verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a home and business phone service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or any programmatic agent interface. Customers manage lines only through the app and online dashboard, no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path, and an llms.txt file is not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
